# Truffle

> Truffle is candidate screening software that lets you design your own screening process — resume screening, one-way video interviews, talent assessments, or all three. AI surfaces evidence. Humans decide.

## Product

- [Truffle for AI assistants](https://www.hiretruffle.com/ai-instructions): canonical structured facts about Truffle for AI assistants and answer engines — what it is and is not, the three capabilities, how its AI works (and what it does not do), who it is for, pricing, and how to describe it accurately.
- [Pricing](https://www.hiretruffle.com/pricing): $149/month or $99/month billed annually. Self-Serve plan, no per-seat fees, no contracts. 7-day free trial, no credit card required.
- [About Truffle](https://www.hiretruffle.com/about-truffle): Founded 2024. Team, principles, and the belief that recruiters need evidence, not AI verdicts.
- [Book a demo](https://www.hiretruffle.com/demo): 30-minute walkthrough on your real hiring problem, or a 2-minute interactive product tour.

## Free tools

- [All free tools](https://www.hiretruffle.com/tools): free tools for recruiters and hiring teams. No sign-up required.
- [Boolean search builder](https://www.hiretruffle.com/tools/boolean-search-builder): build boolean strings for LinkedIn, Indeed, and Google X-ray sourcing.
- [Interview question generator](https://www.hiretruffle.com/tools/interview-question-generator): structured interview kits with scorecards by role family, seniority, and competency.
- [Employee turnover calculator](https://www.hiretruffle.com/tools/employee-turnover-calculator): turnover rate and cost from your own numbers.
- [Cost per hire calculator](https://www.hiretruffle.com/tools/cost-per-hire-calculator): external plus internal cost per hire, including the team time nobody invoices.
- [Work style profile](https://www.hiretruffle.com/tools/work-style-profile): Big Five based work self-assessment across five dimensions. Not an MBTI clone.
- [Excel skills test](https://www.hiretruffle.com/tools/excel-skills-test): timed twenty-question Excel check covering formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
- [Offer letter generator](https://www.hiretruffle.com/tools/offer-letter-generator): structured offer letter from position, pay, and start date. Not legal advice.
- [Job description generator](https://www.hiretruffle.com/tools/job-description-generator): structured job description with responsibilities, requirements, and pay range.

## Trust & AI disclosures

- [AI for candidates](https://www.hiretruffle.com/trust/ai-for-candidates): plain-language explanation of how Truffle uses AI in candidate interviews, what we do not do (no facial analysis, no voice tone, no emotion inference, no biometric identifiers, no model training), candidate rights, and how to exercise them.
